disclaimer.title: Operational guidance, not a legal determination
disclaimer.body: This evaluation is operational guidance generated from state limits recorded in this system. It is not a legal determination, and it does not replace confirming current permit, escort and travel-restriction requirements with each state's permitting authority. Permits and escorts remain the operator's responsibility.

outcomeDescription.clear: Within legal limits in every state the route crosses.
outcomeDescription.oversize: Exceeds a legal size limit (width, height or length) in at least one state on the route.
outcomeDescription.overweight: Exceeds a legal weight limit (gross vehicle or axle) in at least one state on the route.
outcomeDescription.oversize_overweight: Exceeds both a legal size limit and a legal weight limit in at least one state on the route.
outcomeDescription.insufficient_data: One or more inputs is missing, so the outcome cannot be confirmed — see the warnings below.

notes.permitRequired: A state permit is likely required in {state}.
notes.escortRequired: An escort is likely required in {state}.
notes.policeEscortRequired: A police escort is likely required in {state}.

restrictions.holiday: Travel is prohibited on federally observed holidays.

warnings.missingWidth: Width was not entered — this evaluation cannot confirm the load is clear on width.
warnings.missingHeight: Height was not entered — this evaluation cannot confirm the load is clear on height.
warnings.missingLength: Length was not entered — this evaluation cannot confirm the load is clear on length.
warnings.missingGrossWeight: Gross vehicle weight was not entered — this evaluation cannot confirm the load is clear on weight.
warnings.missingAxleWeight: Axle weight was not entered — overweight-per-axle exposure could not be evaluated.
warnings.noRoute: No route could be calculated for this load, so no state's limits could be checked.
warnings.noRouteStates: The route crosses no recognized states, so no state's limits could be checked.

evaluation.title: Oversize / overweight evaluation
evaluation.description: Evaluates the load's dimensions and weight against every state the route crosses.
evaluation.axleWeightHint: Not stored on the load — entered fresh each time an evaluation runs.
evaluation.noEvaluationYet: No evaluation has been run for this load yet.
evaluation.staleBanner: The load's dimensions have changed since this evaluation ran. Run a new evaluation before dispatch.
evaluation.noRouteStatesUsed: No states — no route was available at evaluation time.

panel.noTravelRestrictions: No travel restrictions on file for this state.

validation.title: Admin sign-off
validation.description: Dispatch is blocked for an oversize or overweight load until an Administrator validates this evaluation.
validation.notesPlaceholder: Optional — record why this was validated or rejected.
validation.adminOnly: Only an Administrator may validate an oversize evaluation.
validation.confirmRejectBody: Dispatch will stay blocked until a new evaluation is validated.

rules.title: State oversize rules
rules.description: Per-state legal limits, escort thresholds and travel restrictions. These seed a usable starting point at setup and are fully editable — treat every value as guidance to verify with the state's permitting authority, not a substitute for doing so.

permits.title: Permits
permits.description: State permits required for this load's oversize or overweight movement.
permits.empty: No permits recorded for this load.

escorts.title: Escorts
escorts.description: Pilot cars, police escorts, height poles and route surveys required for this load.
escorts.empty: No escorts recorded for this load.

readiness.title: Permit-ready approval
readiness.description: Admin sign-off that every required permit is issued and unexpired, and every required escort is confirmed.

expiryWarnings.title: Permits expiring soon
expiryWarnings.empty: No permits expiring in the next {days} days.
